headline: Senate resolution that would have blocked a proposed U.S. military sale to the United Arab Emirates did not advance.
what_it_does: This joint resolution would have stopped a proposed sale of certain U.S. defense equipment and services to the government of the United Arab Emirates. Congress can use this kind of resolution to disapprove arms sales that the executive branch plans to make to other countries. On June 11, 2025, the Senate voted not to move forward with it, so the sale was not blocked by this measure.

who_it_affects.group: Government of the United Arab Emirates
who_it_affects.how: It would not have received the defense equipment and services covered by the proposed sale.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. defense companies supplying the items in the sale
who_it_affects.how: They would have lost the business tied to this specific sale if it had been blocked.
